verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Apps can 'integrate into Shopify's admin, online store, checkout and more' [docs-1], and 'Shopify Extensions' exist and can be validated against schemas [docs-35]. Webhooks let an app trigger additional actions after events [docs-43], but that code runs externally, not inside the platform. Missing for 10: any documentation of in-platform serverless functions or hooks, specific support for custom discount, shipping-rule or validation logic, execution and runtime limits, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
